_about: Architecture question: mermaid diagram as context, each option previews its own diagram
title: Where does the webhook processing run?

context.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  S[Stripe] -->|webhook| A[API]
  A --> DB[(Postgres)]
  A --> E[Email]
  A --> L[Ledger sync]
context.caption: Today: everything runs inside the request, so a slow ledger sync times the webhook out.

prompt: How should we move the slow work out of the request?

options.label: Queue + worker
options.subtitle: API enqueues, worker does email and ledger
options.recommended: Retries for free and the API answers in <50 ms

preview.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  S[Stripe] --> A[API]
  A --> Q[[Queue]]
  Q --> W[Worker]
  W --> E[Email]
  W --> L[Ledger]

options.label: Transactional outbox
options.subtitle: Write events in the same transaction, relay later

preview.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[API] --> DB[(DB + outbox)]
  DB --> R[Relay]
  R --> E[Email]
  R --> L[Ledger]

flowchart LR
  S[Stripe] --> A[API]
  A --> E[Email]
  A --> L[Ledger]
